rules.topic: ME mana accounting: 1 byte of mana cell capacity holds 500 mana; the display unit is 1000000 mana (one full mana pool, ManaKeyType.getAmountPerUnit returns the pool capacity)

rules.quote: public static final RegistryObject<Item> MANA_CELL_1K = ITEMS.register("mana_storage_cell_1k",
rules.topic: Mana storage cells mirror AE2's component ladder 1k/4k/16k/64k/256k with cell bytes = kilobytes x 1000 and AE2-matching idle drains 0.5/1.0/1.5/2.0/2.5; effective mana capacity = bytes x 500, so 1k = 500000 mana (half a pool), 256k = 128000000 mana; portable mana cells exist in the same sizes

rules.quote: public static final RegistryObject<Block> FLUIX_MANA_POOL = BLOCKS.register("fluix_mana_pool",
rules.topic: The addon also adds a fluix mana pool block that bridges Botania pools and the ME network (mana moves between pools and ME storage through the addon's import/export strategies); pool-side capacity follows Botania's pool rules (see the botania rule file)
